Graduate Application Process
How to Apply to UC Irvine Mathematics Graduate Programs
Welcome to the UC Irvine Mathematics Department Admissions page! We seek highly motivated applicants for our Ph.D. and M.S. programs in mathematics. Below, you’ll find clear, step-by-step instructions for applying, including deadlines, required materials, and helpful departmental contacts.
Application Timeline
Deadline: December 1 for all materials. Applications are accepted once yearly.
All students are admitted for the Fall quarter only.
Required Application Materials
Here’s a checklist for your application:
GRADUATE APPLICATION PORTAL
Item
Details
UC Irvine Graduate Division Online Application
Graduate Application Portal
Department Selection: School of Physical Sciences – Mathematics – specify Ph.D. or M.S. track.
Application Fee
$135 (US citizens/permanent residents); $155 (international). Fee waivers for eligible U.S. applicants only.
Transcripts
Unofficial transcripts are required for application. Please provide for all institutions attended since high school. Official transcripts are required once admitted.
*English translation/US GPA required for international transcripts.
Three Letters of Recommendation
Digital/PDF upload only
Statement of Purpose
Required for all applicants. Describe academic/research background and goals.
Personal History Statement (Optional)
Discuss how your background may inform your graduate experience/contribution to UC Irvine Math.
GRE Mathematics Test
GRE Math Subject Test: Required for both PhD and MS programs. If extraordinary circumstances prevent you from taking the test (e.g., test center closures, international travel difficulties), you may still submit your application and provide a brief explanation in your Personal History Statement. List a prospective test date as prompted in the application. General GRE is not required.
English Proficiency Test (International Applicants Only)
To obtain admission to the department of mathematics: International applicants must submit a TOEFL score of minimum IBT 80, or IELTS minimum 7, or earned an undergraduate or master’s degree from an institution at which English was the sole language of instruction according to the World Higher Education Database (WHED) and to obtain employment as a TA: international applicants must have a TOEFL-iBT Speaking score of 26+ or IELTS Speaking score of 8+.

General Graduate Division FAQ
We look forward to your application and thank you for considering UC Irvine Mathematics as the next step in your academic journey.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the application deadline?
To be considered for admission and financial support, applicants need to complete their application by the deadline of December 1st for Fall admission.
What is the minimum GPA requirement?
For applicants to our M.S. program, we follow the campus criterion of a minimum GPA of 3.0 based on a 4.0 scale. However, because of the highly competitive nature of admissions, the cutoff can be considerably higher and is currently around 3.3/4.0.
For admission to the Ph.D. program, our expectation is a GPA near 3.5/4.0 or higher. In addition to your GPA, the admissions committee scrutinizes grades in key courses related to your area of interest, particularly upper-division technical courses.
What is the minimum TOEFL score? Is the requirement to be a Teaching Assistant different?
To obtain admissions to the department of mathematics the requirement for minimum TOEFL is 80 on the internet-based test (IBT) and the eligibility for appointment as a UCI Teaching Assistant (TA), international students who are not citizens of countries where English is either the primary or dominant language are required to pass an oral English proficiency exam approved by the UCI campus. Students can fulfill this requirement by passing one of the following exams: TSE, TOEFL (must have 26 or higher in speaking portion), SPEAK, or TOEP. More information on the English Proficiency requirement is available here. Please send your official TOEFL or IETS scores to UC Irvine using Institution Code 4859.
Can my recommenders still submit their recommendation letters after I have submitted my application?
Yes, your recommenders can still submit their letters after you officially submit your application.
Can I have more than 3 letters of recommendation?
Yes, you can have more than 3 letters of recommendation.
I forgot to add something or need to add something to my application, but I have already submitted it. Is it too late for me to submit it?
You can still log into your application through your submission portal and there will be a spot to upload additional documents. These documents can be uploaded as “Post- Submissions Document”. You will not be able to edit/change the content of the application after submission.
Is the GRE subject test score still required?
Yes, the “subject” test score is still required.
What if I can’t submit the GRE subject test score before the application submission due date?
If you are not able to take this exam for reasons beyond your control, such as the need for significant travel, we still encourage you to submit your application to UC Irvine. In that case, please include a short paragraph at the end of your personal statement explaining why you could not take the exam. To submit the application, you will also need to list a future test date. An application with all documents except for the GRE subject exam will still be considered complete and be fully evaluated.
